correctness.rationale: For equal generated embedded sets, each generator is a word in the other and its inverse, so ranks are equal. On a path of v vertices a word of net exponent t has rank at most max(v−|t|,0); on cycles it is exactly the corresponding full permutation power. A word of exponent zero is idempotent, while |t|≥2 loses rank on a nontrivial path. At t=±1, rank equality forces the entire available shift on every chain, hence exactly the original map or its inverse. In the a=1 case the generated set is the cyclic group on its support together with the global identity. For proper support, the global identity alone does not generate it; the group law and the support distinguish all remaining cases, including the empty map, partial identities, and full support at k=1. Labeled j-vertex paths contribute z^j and cycles z^j/j. Divisor inversion extracts the exact cycle LCM, subtraction imposes an exact nontrivial maximum chain size, and division by the proved fiber gives the formula for literal subsets. Rank n and n−1 supply (n+1)n! ambient maps, whereas permutations on subsets total at most e n!, yielding the stated bound for the cycle-only fraction. Fresh independent_check.py in /workspace/branches/6b81b380-80ca-44f5-84dc-774a0d8fac77/ enumerated exact generated sets for 1≤n≤6 and confirmed every joint profile and fiber; totals were 2,6,24,126,838,6841. The frozen verifier was inspected, not executed.
